task.description:
Produce a design artefact for SVC-01 through SVC-04 (Stage 13 — service catalog scope + plugin scope + activation validation + admin API/UI). Classify each requirement per templates/lego-catalog.md and produce the appropriate artefact(s): SVC-01 involves a schema migration + API filtering (Type C + Type E); SVC-02 is in-process plugin registry struct change (Type E); SVC-03 is activation validation cross-module logic (Type E); SVC-04 is new API endpoints + frontend admin page (Type A for API + Type B for UI page). Write artefacts to src/design/svc-01-04-service-scope.md. No implementation code. All public function signatures, error taxonomy, data-flow for cross-module validation, and dependency order must be present.

REWORK 1:
- [MAJOR] templates/specs/svc-04-services-admin-page.list-page.yaml create_form.fields is missing request_schema (textarea, required) and response_schema (textarea, required). Add both fields to the form spec and resubmit.
acceptance_criteria: SVC-01 migration design: new columns scope and owner_tenant_id on service_catalog, CHECK constraint, ON DELETE CASCADE, backfill of existing rows to scope=global
SVC-01 API: GET /api/v1/services filters by caller tenant — only global + owned scoped services returned
SVC-02 plugin struct: PluginScope enum, owner_tenant_id nullable field, dispatch filter logic, freezePluginRegistry duplicate check
SVC-03 activation validator: service catalog lookup + plugin registry check, atomic rejection, runs at DRAFT->ACTIVE and DEPRECATED->ACTIVE
SVC-04 API: POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/admin/services (platform-admin), GET /api/v1/services (tenant-scoped), GET /api/v1/admin/services (platform-admin all)
SVC-04 UI: admin Services page design with columns and role-based Register button

result.summary: REWORK 1: Added request_schema (textarea, required) and response_schema (textarea, required) to create_form.fields in svc-04-services-admin-page.list-page.yaml
